newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines raises power rate in main Luzon island.
newsitem.headline: Philippines raises power rate in main Luzon island.

text.p: State-owned National Power Corp (Napocor) said on Friday it had raised the power rate for the main Philippine island of Luzon by 5.68 centavos to 2.1752 pesos per kilowatt-hour (kwh) starting today.
Napocor said in a statement it was charging 2.1184 pesos per kwh to its customers for last month.
Napocor adjusts its rates every month based on its generating costs and foreign exchange rates. Napocor customers, mostly power distributors, also adjust their rates accordingly.
The rate for the southern island of Mindanao was increased to 1.3581 pesos per kwh from 1.3456 pesos per kwh.
The company also raised the rate in the Cebu-Negros-Panay grid by 4.67 centavos to 2.1733 pesos per kwh, and in the Bohol grid by 2.75 centavos to 2.3039 pesos per kwh.
Rates in the central Leyte-Samar grid were reduced by 0.35 centavos to 2.0987 pesos per kwh.
